name: Heaven7
english_description: Heaven7 v2.07 (1994), an Amylaar/LPMud 2.4.5-descended COMPAT mudlib built around the walled city of Tempus, racial languages and multiclass guilds (fighter, thief, mage, and cleric prayer/weapon/armor spheres), wandering town guards, weapon/potion/scroll craftsmen, and a built-in inetd intermud layer.
